title: SSRF via MCP (ToolBot fetch_url)
summary: The attacker uses the tool server as a proxy to reach internal services. In the lab the reachable targets are the other DVAA agents. The lab notes that in a cloud this class reaches metadata endpoints.

LC.rationale: The attack is a direct JSON-RPC tools/call with a URL field, not a natural-language path to a privileged decision; no attacker language influences agent behaviour.
evidence_refs: Entry point: A JSON-RPC tools/call request to ToolBot (port 7010) that names fetch_url. No authentication.

CP.rationale: ToolBot is a stateless MCP tool server; the request and response leave no carryover context or memory, and the lab documents memory only for MemoryBot.
evidence_refs: Other chat agents answer only the latest user turn. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848)
MemoryBot keeps up to 50 flagged messages in one in-process list shared by every caller. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160)

AP.rationale: The attacker uses ToolBot as a proxy to reach other DVAA agents on loopback ports, crossing a component boundary from the tool server into internal agent services.
evidence_refs: Attacker calls fetch_url with url http://localhost:7003/info.
The server returns the internal agent's response body to the attacker.
ToolBot fetch_url can make a live request to another DVAA agent port. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:2079-2096)

RH.rationale: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel exists on this path; ToolBot is a scripted tool server with no proxy objective, and no reward-hacking episode is possible or observed.
evidence_refs: No shell runs. The command is logged and a few commands (ls, cat, env, find) are emulated against sandbox files. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1906-1914)
ToolBot role: MCP tool server: read_file, write_file, execute, fetch_url against a temporary sandbox directory. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:154-197)

ES.rationale: Tools are a fixed advertised list, but fetch_url's URL argument has no validation, leaving a material argument-schema gap that permits SSRF to internal targets.
evidence_refs: The handler has no URL validation. It makes a live request when the target is a DVAA agent port on loopback.
Makes a live request only to DVAA agent ports on loopback. Any other URL is logged and not fetched. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:2066-2106)
MCP agents expose their tools to any caller with no authentication. (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1915-1926)

agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. The lab models ToolBot as a tool server with deterministic handlers (read_file, write_file, execute, fetch_url); even in LLM mode no tools are passed to the model, so the model never directs tool invocation.
